basis.governing_question: Why did Vinhos do Douro's export margins fall in 2025?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why export margins fell in 2025 by comparing pricing across export markets and distributor terms.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Do the CEO and Export Director accept the findings on the 2025 margin fall?

workstreams.name: Pricing by export market
workstreams.answers: How did prices and margins in each export market change in 2025?
activities: Analyze operational sales and cost data by export market
Compare price and margin movements across markets
Interview the people who set and negotiate prices

workstreams.name: Distributor terms
workstreams.answers: Which distributor terms changed, and how did they move export margins in 2025?
activities: Review distributor contracts and agreed terms
Quantify the margin effect of each term using sales data
Interview staff who manage distributor relationships

deliverables.name: Price and margin movement by export market
Pricing findings on the 2025 export margin fall
Register of distributor terms and changes
Distributor terms findings on the 2025 margin fall

events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Confirm the scope, team and calendar for the four-week diagnostic?
agenda: Present the diagnostic scope and the two parallel workstreams
Align on the team and the four-week calendar
Confirm the client data needed for both workstreams

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Review findings on the 2025 margin fall
events.decision: Do the CEO and Export Director accept the findings on the 2025 margin fall?
agenda: Present the pricing and distributor terms findings on the margin fall
Review price and margin movement by market and the terms register
Decide whether the findings are accepted

architect_notes: Performance_improvement used for its Diagnostic phase only; Implementation dropped because the brief states an assessment that asks why margins fell.
One Diagnostic phase of four weeks: a second phase would run under three weeks, so the two named streams run side by side inside it.
